text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Brian. I'm afraid I can't let you pass 
here.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: T-That's right! You shall not pass!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just stand proud, Biko. There's nothing 
that guy can do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Because unlike you, that guy— left behind 
the parsley garnish, that's why!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's not fair! Even I'm doing my best 
to eat properly!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to strike with the iron 
hammer of justice! Get 'em, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
On my honor as a hero, no leftovers 
allowed! —Today's the day I power up with 
parsley!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...... ...Don't you guys have anything 
better to do?
